captions.detailed: A classic square household box fan made of a light gray plastic housing. Inside the housing, a light gray three-blade rotor is mounted on a central black motor shaft. The front features a square, snap-on grid-patterned grille panel that can swing open on a side-edge hinge, while a small black cylindrical speed-control knob is located on the right side panel for continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a classic square household box fan with a light gray housing, a snap-on front grille panel, an internal three-blade rotor, and a side speed-control knob. The rotor should have a continuous rotation joint, the front grille should swing on a revolute hinge, and the knob should rotate continuously on its shaft.
captions.factory: The box fan is built by first modeling a hollow square housing using a boolean subtraction of two box primitives, with additional cutouts for the side knob. The rotor is constructed using a central cylinder for the hub and three extruded blade shapes, attached via a continuous joint. The front grille is created from a grid of thin boxes and attached to the housing via a revolute joint along its side edge. Finally, the speed-control knob is modeled as a small cylinder with an indicator notch and attached to the right panel using a continuous joint.
